title: The only blueprint for long-running agent coding
description: Long coding tasks break most agents. They lose context halfway through and start going off the rails. Here is the blueprint I use to keep one agent running a full build start to finish. I go deep on this inside Agent Architects, our community for people building real agent systems. Link in bio, we would love to see you there. skool.com/agent-architects/about
